packages.title: Server identity before a write
exit: Closes m5b F4 (docs/reviews/round3-save.md): the identity proof covers the connection that carries the write, and a copied /ready answer does not pass it

check-server-identity.mjs swaps the scratch server for a recording listener during --wait-before-write. The listener receives no byte of the POST, and the client exits 1 with WRONG_SERVER or a connection error and does not retry. With only the flag added and the old mutate, the check fails
A listener that replays headers copied from a real scratch server /ready answer gets no write (tst_serveridentity and the check script)

ServerClient::upload takes the same proof: a listener that replaces the server after the identity check receives no byte of the multipart body, and an upload to the scratch server still stores the asset (tst_serveridentity)
mutate and upload keep the signatures S1 gave them, so merged A and B need no change
scratch-safety.test.mjs: mutate and upload send no body to a replacement listener
A save against the scratch server still writes, and timeline.get returns the edit. tst_autosave and tst_serverclient pass
A client with no expected instance sends one request (mutateWithoutAnExpectationSendsDirectly)
No check sends a request to port 7777
